raw_segments.text: Yes, said Lee. I wish I had as good not that mine are to complain of. There's no stinginess
at Thornfield, but they're not one-fifth of the sum Mrs. Poole receives. And she is
laying by. She goes every quarter to the bank at Millcote. I should not wonder but she has
saved enough to keep her independent if she liked to leave. But I suppose she's got used
to the place. And then she's not forty yet and strong and able for anything. It is too
soon for her to give up business.
